indirect_leakage_in_06a8a09_D1: sigma_b LORO used stored residuals of training routes whose mu_M models were themselves trained with the outer route included (e.g. R2 residuals from a model trained on R4+R5 when R5 is the outer route).
summary: mu_M/mu_B/R were each fit route-held-out, so the published per-route values are OOF; a fully nested LORO needs retraining mu_M (HGB) and R inside each outer fold from the 902ddca code and artifact inputs whose availability was not verified here. Until then 06a8a09 D1 is named '고정 OOF mu,R 위에서의 2단계 분산표 경로 제외 재적합'.
